name: hcapp_addEditUser
description: Creates or updates a Hasher record. Dual-mode: when @deviceId is NULL it operates as a new-user creation flow (first app launch, no device record exists yet) — no token validation is performed. When @deviceId is provided it validates the access token (bound to DeviceSecret + UPPER(@targetUserId)) and performs an edit against an existing user. On success, delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData, hcapp_syncKennelAdminData, or hcapp_syncUserData depending on context, or returns the new HasherProfile directly in new-user mode.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. NULL triggers new-user creation mode — no token validation. When provided, resolves the caller's userId and DeviceSecret from HC.Device.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth token. Validated against DeviceSecret + UPPER(@targetUserId). Only checked when @deviceId is not NULL.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version string. Used only in ErrorLog and LaunchAndLogin inserts — not stored on Hasher.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed through to the child sync SP.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed through to the child sync SP.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed through to the child sync SP.

parameters.name: targetUserId
parameters.description: User to create or edit. Default null-UUID ('00000000-...') triggers insert mode — a new UUID is generated internally. On edit, must be an existing Hasher.id.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address. Empty string normalised to NULL. Duplicate email check performed across all other Hasher records.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL. Widened from HC5 NVARCHAR(100) to match Hasher.FirstName NVARCHAR(250).

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL. Widened from HC5 NVARCHAR(100) to match Hasher.LastName NVARCHAR(250).

parameters.name: hashName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL. Widened from HC5 NVARCHAR(100) to match Hasher.HashName NVARCHAR(250).

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL. Widened from HC5 NVARCHAR(500) to match Hasher.Photo NVARCHAR(1000).

parameters.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no update). Table column is SMALLINT — INT parameter is wider than the column.
parameters.typeMismatch: INT vs Hasher.IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory SMALLINT — no truncation risk in practice, but types don't match.

parameters.name: preferences
parameters.description: Bitfield. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no update). On new user insert, defaults to 14 + @useUsaMiles if not provided.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: When provided and non-null-UUID: new user is added to this event's HasherEventMap; on success, calls hcapp_syncEventAdminData instead of hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: When provided and non-null-UUID: may add new user to this kennel (controlled by @followKennelOnAddNewUser); also sets Hasher.HomeKennelId on insert; on success (no @eventId), calls hcapp_syncKennelAdminData instead of hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: historicalTotalRunCount
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no update). Applied on insert to HasherKennelMap, or on edit if @kennelId is provided.

parameters.name: historicalHaringCount
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no update). Applied on insert to HasherKennelMap, or on edit if @kennelId is provided.

parameters.name: historicalCountIsEstimate
parameters.description: Flag: whether the historical counts are estimates. Applied alongside historicalTotalRunCount / historicalHaringCount.

parameters.name: followKennelOnAddNewUser
parameters.description: When non-zero and @kennelId is provided, a HasherKennelMap record is created for the new user. Only meaningful in insert mode.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Used to detect if user is in the US for miles/km preference default on new user insert. Also stored as Hasher.HomeLatitude.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(18,15) vs Hasher.HomeLatitude DECIMAL(12,9) — parameter is wider in both precision and scale. No overflow risk for valid lat/lng values, but types are mismatched.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Used to detect if user is in the US for miles/km preference default on new user insert. Also stored as Hasher.HomeLongitude.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(19,15) vs Hasher.HomeLongitude DECIMAL(13,9) — parameter is wider in both precision and scale. No overflow risk for valid lat/lng values, but types are mismatched.

parameters.name: nameDisplayPreference
parameters.description: 1=hash name first, 2=real name first. Sentinel: <= 0 normalised to NULL (no update). Table column is SMALLINT.
parameters.typeMismatch: INT vs Hasher.NameDisplayPreference SMALLINT — no truncation risk for valid values 1/2.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as the first rowset. success=1 on success, success=0 on any error path.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Error code on failure: 1110=invalid token, 1310=device/user not found, 1510=duplicate email, 1910=unhandled DB error.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 11=auth failure (token invalid), 13=device or target user not found, 15=business rule violation (duplicate email), 19=unhandled CATCH error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Only returned when success=0. Provides human-readable and debug context for the error.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for this error instance.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Matches errorType in the SuccessEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Matches errorCode in the SuccessEnvelope rowset.

rowsets.name: NewUserProfile
rowsets.description: Only returned when success=1 AND new-user mode (@deviceId IS NULL, or @userId resolved to null-UUID). Returns the newly created Hasher record directly instead of delegating to a sync SP.

columns.name: dispName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName computed column, coalesced to empty string.

columns.name: preferences
columns.description: Hasher.Preferences cast to NVARCHAR — string representation of the INT bitfield.

rowsets.name: SyncDelegateResult
rowsets.description: Only returned when success=1 AND edit mode (device authenticated). The result sets from the delegated sync SP are passed through directly: hcapp_syncEventAdminData (if @eventId provided), hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (if @kennelId provided, no @eventId), or hcapp_syncUserData (fallback). Number and shape of rowsets depend on the delegated SP.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Hasher — on new user creation
INSERT HC.LaunchAndLogin — on new user creation
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if @eventId provided and new user
INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — if @kennelId provided, new user, and @followKennelOnAddNewUser != 0
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — if @kennelId provided and historical counts specified on edit
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on any error path
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — if @eventId provided and edit mode
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncKennelAdminData — if @kennelId provided (and no @eventId) and edit mode
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData — fallback in edit mode when neither @eventId nor @kennelId provided

codeSmells.issue: Auth checks and device lookup occur outside TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: The device lookup, null-userId guard, and token validation (lines 116–154) execute before BEGIN TRY. Any unexpected error in HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 or the Device SELECT would be uncaught and surface as a raw SQL error rather than the standard HC6 error envelope. The pattern is intentional (early-exit before the transaction) but violates the standard error contract.

codeSmells.issue: Parameter type mismatch — @latitude / @longitude wider than table columns
codeSmells.detail: @latitude DECIMAL(18,15) vs Hasher.HomeLatitude DECIMAL(12,9). @longitude DECIMAL(19,15) vs Hasher.HomeLongitude DECIMAL(13,9). Parameters accept higher precision than the table can store. Values will be silently rounded on INSERT. No data loss for normal lat/lng values but the mismatch is a documentation gap.

codeSmells.issue: Parameter type mismatch — @nameDisplayPreference INT vs Hasher.NameDisplayPreference SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: INT parameter vs SMALLINT column. Safe for the valid values 1 and 2, but the parameter could accept values outside the SMALLINT range without error at the SP boundary.

codeSmells.issue: Parameter type mismatch — @includeInGlobalHashDirectory INT vs Hasher.IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: Same issue as @nameDisplayPreference — INT accepted, SMALLINT stored. Safe for values 0/1 but types don't align.

codeSmells.issue: No authorization check when editing another user's record
codeSmells.detail: When @targetUserId differs from the caller's @userId (admin editing another user), no check is made whether the caller has mismanagement or admin rights for that user's kennel. Any authenticated device can edit any other user's profile by providing a valid token bound to the target UUID.

Line 316 declares '@procName10 NVARCHAR(128) = @procName' solely to pass to hcapp_syncEventAdminData because @procName is already used as the outer variable. @procName could be passed directly — the intermediate alias adds confusion without purpose.

codeSmells.issue: New user profile rowset condition uses @userId sentinel comparison
codeSmells.detail: Line 295: 'IF (@isNewUserMode = 1 OR @userId = ''00000000-...'')'. The OR branch is redundant — @userId is only ever '00000000-...' when @isNewUserMode = 1. The second condition is dead code.

breakingChanges: @deviceId type changed from NVARCHAR(100) to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — callers passing a string UUID will break unless the client converts to the native type.
@firstName, @lastName, @hashName widened from NVARCHAR(100) to NVARCHAR(250) — no breaking change for callers; wider is backwards compatible.
@photo widened from NVARCHAR(500) to NVARCHAR(1000) — no breaking change for callers; wider is backwards compatible.
@historicalPackRunCount removed entirely — callers that pass this parameter must stop doing so (extra parameter will cause an error).
errorType for duplicate email changed from 10005 to 5, errorCode changed to 1510 — callers checking for errorType=10005 will not detect the duplicate email condition.
New success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 — callers expecting the first rowset to be the profile or sync data must shift their rowset index expectations by 1.
NewUserProfile rowset no longer includes facebookId or qrSecretCode columns — callers reading those fields from the new-user response will receive null or missing data.
TRY/CATCH added — unhandled DB errors now return errorType=19/errorCode=1910 instead of surfacing as raw SQL errors.
